tools.name: 90° V-bit 1/2″, 7/16″ cut (Diablo DR20104)
tools.notes: Diablo DR20104 1/2″ carbide V-groove bit, 90° (45° per side), 2 cutters, TiCo carbide with non-stick coating. Carbide height 7/16″ (11.11 mm), overall length 1-3/4″ (44.45 mm), shank 1/4″. Diablo lists a maximum of 24000 rpm and CNC machines among its uses; for engraving, signmaking and veining. Very close to CMT 815.127.11 but with a slightly shorter cutting edge. Dimensions from Diablo's product page; feeds and speeds are conservative starting values, not Diablo's.

tools.name: 1/8″ straight Z2, 3/8″ cut (Diablo DR04100)
tools.notes: Diablo DR04100 double-flute straight router bit, TiCo Hi-Density carbide, 2 cutters. Carbide height 3/8″ (9.52 mm), overall length 1-3/4″ (44.45 mm), shank 1/4″ (6.35 mm). Hand-router bit: fine for light CNC work in wood and composites, with shallow passes. Dimensions from a retailer's listing of the Diablo item number; feeds and speeds are conservative starting values, not Diablo's.
